spec.goal: Migrate every product surface onto the new design system without reaching into @voyado/ui internals.
constraints: must not change the public API of @voyado/ui

priorDecisions.decision: The internal namespace stays private; consumers import from the package root
priorDecisions.rationale: The internal tree is refactored on every minor release

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Every migrated component renders with the new tokens.
The package still typechecks under the new component types.

knownFailureModes.description: a migrated component reaches into the internal namespace for a token it cannot find
knownFailureModes.detection: the import-boundary gate walks every import specifier in the changed files
knownFailureModes.mitigation: publish the missing token from the package root before the migration node runs
